activity_summary: At eleven, in a quiet house, you folded two sheets of Field's crown paper into small leaves and wrote a fourteen-liner on each. The first is slow, on seasons passing since a first sight, and it carries no name and no superscription. The second is short-breathed and against yourself, on desire that knows the better course and does not take it. You signed neither. You turned the second face down. You did not hand either to anyone.
